title: Wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
description: Always wear a lab coat, safety goggles, gloves, and closed-toe shoes while working in the laboratory.
prevention: Inspect PPE before use and replace damaged equipment immediately.
emergency: If exposed to chemicals, remove contaminated clothing and rinse the affected area with water.

title: Read Chemical Labels Carefully
description: Read labels and Safety Data Sheets (SDS) before using any chemical.
prevention: Verify the chemical name, concentration, hazards, and storage instructions.
emergency: Stop using unidentified chemicals and report them to the lab supervisor.

title: Handle Chemicals Carefully
description: Never smell or taste chemicals directly. Use proper handling techniques and laboratory tools.
prevention: Use fume hoods when working with volatile or toxic substances.
emergency: If inhalation occurs, move to fresh air immediately and seek medical attention if needed.

title: Proper Chemical Storage
description: Store chemicals according to their compatibility and hazard classification.
prevention: Keep flammable, corrosive, oxidizing, and toxic chemicals in designated storage areas.
emergency: Isolate leaking containers and inform laboratory personnel immediately.

title: Safe Waste Disposal
description: Dispose of chemical waste only in designated waste containers.
prevention: Never pour hazardous chemicals into sinks unless instructed.
emergency: Contain spills using approved spill kits and report the incident.

title: Fire Safety
description: Keep flammable materials away from ignition sources and know the location of fire extinguishers.
prevention: Avoid open flames near flammable solvents.
emergency: Activate the fire alarm, use the correct extinguisher if safe, and evacuate if necessary.

title: Know Emergency Equipment
description: Be familiar with eyewash stations, safety showers, fire blankets, and first aid kits.
prevention: Locate emergency equipment before starting any experiment.
emergency: Use emergency equipment immediately following an accident.

title: Keep the Laboratory Clean
description: Maintain a clean and organized workspace to reduce accidents.
prevention: Clean spills immediately and keep work areas free from unnecessary materials.
emergency: Report hazardous spills that cannot be cleaned safely.

title: No Eating or Drinking
description: Eating, drinking, and smoking are prohibited inside the laboratory.
prevention: Keep food and beverages outside laboratory areas.
emergency: Discard contaminated food immediately.

title: Report Accidents Immediately
description: Report every accident, spill, or injury immediately, regardless of its severity.
prevention: Inform the laboratory supervisor as soon as an incident occurs.
emergency: Follow emergency response procedures and seek medical assistance if required.

title: Use Fume Hoods Properly
description: Always use a fume hood when handling volatile, toxic, or hazardous chemicals that release harmful vapors.
prevention: Keep the sash at the recommended height and avoid blocking airflow.
emergency: If exposed to hazardous fumes, move to fresh air immediately and seek medical assistance.

title: Inspect Glassware Before Use
description: Check all laboratory glassware for cracks, chips, or damage before use.
prevention: Replace damaged glassware immediately to prevent breakage.
emergency: Clean broken glass using a brush and dustpan, never with bare hands.

title: Electrical Equipment Safety
description: Inspect electrical equipment before use and keep it away from water or wet surfaces.
prevention: Switch off equipment before connecting or disconnecting power.
emergency: Disconnect power immediately and report damaged equipment.

title: Gas Cylinder Handling
description: Secure gas cylinders upright using chains or straps and transport them with approved trolleys.
prevention: Always close the valve after use and use the correct pressure regulator.
emergency: If a gas leak is suspected, evacuate the area and notify laboratory personnel immediately.

title: Prevent Cross-Contamination
description: Use clean tools and containers for each chemical to avoid contamination.
prevention: Never return unused chemicals to the original container.
emergency: Dispose of contaminated chemicals following laboratory waste procedures.

title: Emergency Evacuation Procedure
description: Know the emergency exits and assembly points before beginning laboratory work.
prevention: Keep exit pathways clear at all times.
emergency: Leave the laboratory calmly and follow staff instructions during emergencies.

title: Proper Use of Laboratory Instruments
description: Operate laboratory instruments only after receiving proper training.
prevention: Read the operating instructions before using any equipment.
emergency: Switch off malfunctioning equipment and report it immediately.

title: Laboratory First Aid Awareness
description: Know the location of first aid kits and basic first aid procedures before starting work.
prevention: Ensure first aid kits remain fully stocked and easily accessible.
emergency: Provide first aid if trained and contact medical personnel immediately.

title: Maintain Proper Laboratory Ventilation
description: Ensure the laboratory ventilation system is functioning properly before beginning experiments.
prevention: Do not block air vents or ventilation openings.
emergency: Stop experiments if ventilation fails and leave the area if hazardous vapors are present.

title: Practice Safe Chemical Transportation
description: Transport chemicals using appropriate containers and secondary containment when necessary.
prevention: Carry only small quantities and keep containers tightly closed.
emergency: If a spill occurs during transport, isolate the area and follow the spill response procedure.
